mapper.subject: ACTION NEEDED! Please read and accept the terms for the Hardship Scholarship.
mapper.content:
Review your scholarship guidelines

Hello {{1.`3`}},

Thank you for applying for a Paducah GO Soccer scholarship for {{1.`8`}}.

To continue the scholarship process, please review and accept the Paducah GO Soccer Scholarship Guidelines. Your personalized agreement already includes the information provided in your application.

Please use the button below to review and accept the agreement:

Review and Accept Scholarship Guidelines

If you have any questions or need assistance, please contact us.

Thank you,
Paducah GO Soccer
LifePrep Academy Foundation
